content.title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
content.focus: Management of valvular heart disease, particularly aortic and bicuspid aortic valves (BAV).
key_points: Bicuspid aortic valve is associated with aortopathy due to its unique valvular phenotype.
Regular monitoring via imaging such as CT or echocardiography is recommended for individuals with bicuspid aortic valves.
Interventions for patients with BAV may include replacement or repair of the aorta and aortic valve.
Annual review of aortic dimensions for patients with enlarged aortic roots is advised.
